title: Pentagon Expands Its Central AI Portal With ChatGPT and Grok
dek: The Defense Department is adding versions of OpenAI’s ChatGPT and SpaceXAI’s Grok to a central AI-tools portal that already includes Google’s Gemini.
socialCaption: The Pentagon is adding versions of ChatGPT and Grok to its central AI-tools portal, alongside Google’s Gemini. The notable signal for enterprise leaders: AI access may be managed as a multi-vendor platform, not a single-model bet.
